data.source: Existing Hyper-SAGNN train_data.npz and test_data.npz files
data.positive_tuple_sanitization: Stable-deduplicate training positives, stable-deduplicate test positives, then remove every test tuple present in the deduplicated training set before splitting training into core and development partitions.
data.context_policy: Only positive hyperedges in the remaining core-training partition form the context hypergraph. Development and test candidates are never context incidences.
data.negative_rule: Replace one typed position and reject every tuple present in core train, development, or sanitized test positives.
data.evaluation_negatives: Fixed once per dataset and split by deterministic seeds recorded in each run.

model.node_features: Trainable node embeddings only; no adjacency embedding constructed from development or test hyperedges.
model.context_aggregation: Weighted incidence node-to-edge mean followed by weighted edge-to-node mean, projected and added residually to candidate token embeddings.
model.training_context_sampling: Sample without replacement from core-training hyperedges incident to at least one scored candidate node, excluding the scored positive hyperedges; fill any remaining bounded-context slots uniformly from other core-training hyperedges.

sparsification.budget: K=max(1,floor(0.5*M)) over M core-training context incidences
sparsification.Random-Fixed: One uniform exact-K incidence mask is sampled per seed and kept fixed throughout training and evaluation.
sparsification.EHGNN-F: One free logit per core-training context incidence; stochastic exact-K multinomial mask in training and deterministic exact top-K deployment.
sparsification.gradient_estimator: Selected-only straight-through incidence weights, matching the main EHGNN-F method.

training.checkpoint: Detached CPU clone at the best development AUC; test is evaluated once after restoration.

reporting.summary: mean and sample standard deviation over five model seeds
